MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The ten-foot HDMI cable feels useful because its extra length could help me route a display connection around my setup more neatly than my earlier six-foot cable.",
    "The USB hub fits my pattern of connecting practical computer accessories: I could plug in my keyboard receiver and other low-bandwidth peripherals and switch them off individually."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The streaming devices and smart speakers add new entertainment or voice-assistant equipment, while my recent purchases focus on connecting, organizing, carrying, and maintaining equipment I already use.",
    "The wired earbuds match my past audio purchases, but I already have several headphones, so that familiarity does not give me a reason to buy another pair now.",
    "Having bought a Kindle does not mean I need a tablet or smart display; neither addresses a current need evident in my recent shopping."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My interest in electronics seems to have been treated as interest in almost any electronic device, without enough attention to the job I need it to do.",
    "My earlier Amazon-device purchases seem to have been taken as a reason to suggest more Amazon devices, even when their uses differ from my recent purchases."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My recent Ethernet adapter, network cables, headphone mount, and electric duster point toward improving and maintaining an existing computer workspace.",
    "A useful addition needs a concrete benefit, such as extra cable reach or more peripheral connections; another device with a familiar purpose may simply duplicate equipment I already have."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations recognized my interest in electronics but missed that I currently want practical improvements to my existing setup."
}
